transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I came because I just feel flat inside. My children can be sitting with me, or I’ll look out at the sun on my garden, things that used to comfort me... and I can’t feel glad or comforted. It’s like that part of me has shut off.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About two weeks now—ever since my husband collapsed and the paramedics were working on him in our kitchen.
Since that happened, have you been having unwanted memories, flashbacks, or nightmares about his collapse?
I’m not sure what you mean by flashbacks. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
How has your sleep been over these past two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep, to be honest.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling like this before in your life?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time quite like this.
Aside from feeling flat, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know that I’ve felt sad exactly. I just… I haven’t really been keeping track of it.
Do you ever feel detached from yourself, as if you are watching yourself from the outside or moving through life like a robot?
Sometimes I’ll walk through my own kitchen and it looks like someone else’s house. It’s like I’m moving around in a dream, not really there.
Even when your surroundings feel like a dream, do you still realize that this is just a sensation and that you are actually awake in the real world?
Yes, I know I’m awake. It just doesn’t feel real sometimes—like my kitchen is somebody else’s house and I’m moving through a dream.
